card.description: An end-to-end RAG system for retrieving information from telecommunications technical documentation and generating grounded answers with citations.

details.subtitle: Graduation Project · 2026
details.overview: Designed, implemented, and evaluated an end-to-end RAG system for retrieving information from telecommunications technical documentation and generating grounded answers with citations.
details.problem: Retrieving reliable information from technical documentation requires finding relevant passages and checking whether the available evidence supports an answer.
details.solution: Developed a retrieval pipeline with query routing, semantic and lexical retrieval, contextual reranking, and LLM-based generation, with a verification step before answer generation.
features: Query router to determine whether a query requires rewriting
Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion combining semantic retrieval and BM25
Chat history and citation-based document navigation
methodology: Query routing and conditional query rewriting

card.description: A machine learning project applying feature engineering and predictive models to estimate advertisement click-through rates.

details.subtitle: Machine Learning Project
details.overview: Applied feature engineering and machine learning models to predict advertisement click-through rates using a real-world dataset.
details.problem: Predicting whether an advertisement will receive a click is a classification task that can be approached using historical data and engineered features.
details.solution: Applied feature engineering, trained machine learning models, and evaluated and compared different approaches using a real-world dataset.
